oracle_interpretation: diagnostic interventions, not universal accuracy bounds; component additionally knows clean target contribution
warp: frontoparallel reference optical Z, fixed for every arm
mask_semantics: joint common weights across reference and both sources; center uses bilinearly sampled center membership threshold 0.5, footprint/majority uses sampled footprint confidence threshold 0.5, pure uses fraction>=0.99999999, fraction uses min joint fraction as continuous weight; component uses majority mask with target numerator divided by target fraction
